Customer Reviews

SM
Sarah M.
Cascade Township
Emergency Repair

I called Northline at 2am on a Wednesday in February with a burst pipe in our basement. Water was coming in fast and I was panicking. Dave answered on the second ring, asked a few quick questions, and had a technician at our door inside of an hour. He stopped the water, replaced the damaged section, and even helped us set up some towels and showed us where to aim a fan before he left. I could not have been more relieved. This is our family's plumber for life — no question.

January 2024

TK
Tom K.
Kentwood
Water Heater Replacement

Our 14-year-old water heater finally gave up the ghost on a Saturday morning — cold showers all around. I called a couple places and they told me earliest they could get to us was Tuesday or Wednesday. Called Northline, Karen picked up immediately, and they had someone out by 11am same day. The tech explained the options, didn't try to upsell me on the most expensive unit, and had everything installed and running before 2pm. They even hauled away the old tank. I was genuinely shocked at how smooth the whole experience was.

March 2024

Ada Township
Long-time Customer

We’ve used Northline for twelve years now. In that time they’ve done everything from a simple faucet rebuild to a complete plumbing rough-in for our home addition. Karen in the office is always helpful and responsive. Every technician they’ve sent has been professional, clean, and honest about what actually needs to be done versus what can wait. We’ve recommended them to at least six or seven friends and neighbors over the years. The consistency over twelve years is what impresses me most — they don’t seem to have off days.

MR
Mike R.
Walker
Boiler Service & Repair

Got three estimates for a boiler tune-up and a persistent pressure leak. Northline wasn’t the cheapest, but they were by far the most thorough. Dave came out himself, actually looked at the whole system, and showed me exactly what was causing the pressure drop and why. He didn’t try to sell me a new boiler or a bunch of extras I didn’t need. Fixed the leak, did the tune-up, charged what he quoted, and gave me a clear rundown of what to watch over the next year. No surprises on the invoice. I’ve already booked the annual service for next fall.

October 2023

LP
Linda P.
Forest Hills
Drain Cleaning

We had a recurring slow drain in our kitchen that two other companies "fixed" — it came back both times within a few months. Northline came out, ran their camera, and showed me a root intrusion about 40 feet out that nobody had seen. Cleared it properly with hydrojetting and treated the roots. That was 14 months ago and we haven’t had a problem since. Sometimes you get what you pay for, and this was worth every penny.

August 2023
